function.name: get_current_time
function.description: Get the current time for a requested timezone. Supports UTC and local system timezone names accepted by date/TZ.

timezone.description: Timezone name, for example UTC or Europe/Bucharest.

function.name: count_files
function.description: Count files below a repository path, excluding .git.

path.description: Relative path to count from. Use . for the repository root.

function.name: summarize_text
function.description: Produce a simple deterministic local summary of short text.
